weaknesses: The abstract does not clearly articulate the limitations of the Neural Quadratic Models in comparison to traditional neural networks.
The empirical results lack a comprehensive comparison with existing models beyond the stated neural networks, limiting the scope of the findings.
Some claims about the generalization performance of NQMs are not sufficiently supported by the experimental data presented.
strengths: The paper introduces a novel perspective on the dynamics of neural networks through the lens of quadratic models, contributing to the understanding of the catapult phase.
The theoretical analysis is rigorous and well-structured, providing a solid foundation for the empirical findings.
The experiments demonstrate a clear correlation between the behavior of NQMs and traditional neural networks, highlighting the relevance of the proposed models.
